title: 第5章 天使索菲莉第6章 魅魔菲莉
slug: 兼职管理女子监狱的异端审判官
content_zh:
这片区域的所有犯人都清晰的记得，那名原本高高在上的血族亲王被折磨到最后时已经没有了任何傲慢与反抗，只会像狗狗一般匍匐在狄曼列的脚底求饶
但狄曼列依旧没有放过她，对于这种已经触碰了律法与道德双重底线，漠视生命的罪犯，他并不打算施以任何怜悯，他只是一遍遍的用圣水和诅咒，撕扯着这名血族亲王的躯体与灵魂，甚至在她精神即将崩溃时施展安抚人心的魔法，而后重复这个过程
如今这名血族亲王的精神与躯体其实都被修复到了最初的状态，但那份记忆与恐惧却是被深深刻进了她的本能
如今的她比起渴求杀戮和鲜血，似乎更渴求书籍与知识，只是每次放风期间看到狄曼列，她还是会假装在思考哲学，然后迅速逃跑
这片区域所关押的重刑犯，几乎每一个都被狄曼列修理过，其中不乏一些被修理过还是死活不长记性的家伙，但她们基本也只敢嘴上随便骂两句普通的脏话，该服从的命令和制度一个不差
暂且放下对这些重刑犯的审视，狄曼列没有立刻走向更前方的区域，而是轻握手杖
随着机括声响起，手杖的主体在瞬间化为一根锋利的链锯，些许弱小但危险的魔力流淌而过，散发着令周围犯人胆寒的气息
许多犯人见识过这根手杖，它是狄曼列常用的武器之一，这把可以在手杖型短刃与链锯间切换的武器，在所有犯人的心中都留下了难以磨灭的阴影
那是两年前的一个夜晚，随着狄曼列受了重伤的传言散播开来，许多犯人都蠢蠢欲动，甚至开始明面上对抗狱警和监狱的秩序
在这种犯人愈演愈烈的暴动状态下，监狱的正常运转受到极大阻碍，许多狱警也受了伤，甚至当时还是狄曼列身边秘书的赫尔莎，也差点失去双腿变成终生残疾
在某一天，狄曼列给所有狱警放了假，而后打开了所有牢房的大门，甚至解除了所有犯人身上的魔导限制囚具
正当犯人们不知是惊喜还是茫然的时候，狄曼列的声音从广播中响起了
『仅此一天，我会放开所有限制，想越狱的就来吧，我在正门口等你们，其他地方都启动了禁咒』
犯人们不是傻子，自然怀疑这是什么计谋，但对自由的渴求已经压过了一切，除了部分刑期只剩几个月甚至几天的犯人，其他犯人几乎全参与了这场盛势浩大的越狱
当这批足以轻易毁灭一座大型城市的危险罪犯来到大门口时，只能看到那名紫发青年静静地坐在月光下，静静地抱着那根手杖
没人敢立刻上去试探狄曼列的虚实，也没人敢踏进那不知存不存在的阴谋
但随着时间流逝，所有的罪犯还是一拥而上，扑向了那名并不健硕的紫发青年
事实证明，她们猜错了，那不是一场阴谋，仅仅只是一场————屠杀
那一夜，监狱大门前的广场被染成了红色
头颅，残肢、内脏、碎掉的魔导石，将广场染成了死亡国度的景象

仅仅一根手杖，所有的魔法、咒术、力量、战技、卷轴、魔具，全部像是玩具一般，被轻而易举的撕碎了
直到月光与晨曦交替，广场上唯一站着的，只有慢悠悠将链刃变回手杖的紫发青年
他的脸庞与身上那件黑色大衣已经被各种颜色的鲜血浸透，但却没有任何一滴血属于他，他只是默默计算着杀掉犯人的数量，以及要写的工作报告
自那之后，再也没有任何一名犯人敢挑战鸢尾花监狱的规则，只能像一只遭遇猛兽的野狗，默默收起獠牙
而此刻，随着狄曼列轻甩链锯，而后猛然在地上一拄，手杖也再次浮现
他继续迈开步伐，朝牢房最深处的区域走了过去
其实关于狄曼列曾经是异端审判官的传言，大多数人心中都是默认过这是真的
只不过无论是鸢尾花监狱内的犯人和狱警，还是水晶城的平民与贵族，都会忍不住猜测狄曼列究竟是哪个等级的异端审判官
如果狄曼列真的是受了重伤，那么凭他如今拥有的实力，曾经没受伤时绝对是高等审判官
这样的存在，就算受了重伤，也绝不应该会被派到水晶城这种小城市，更别提担任一座女子监狱的典狱长
其中的缘由和狄曼列本身对各种事情的态度，都能一定程度上表明水晶城很多领域的走向
只是狄曼列暂时也不关心这些，他无视了两旁犯人们的视线，缓缓打开了最后一片区域的大门
这是唯有狄曼列可以打开的门，所有狱警包括副典狱长赫尔莎在内，都只允许停留在这里，其上的魔法阵与防御机制足够将外面所有的犯人灭杀无数遍，更别提这扇大门本身就是一件出自异端审判局某个部门的炼金产物
随着一道道验证步骤造成，整扇黑色合金大门猛然亮起，紧接着蒸汽与魔导纹路遍布大门，而后缓缓打开
狄曼列受了重伤这件事是真的，只不过是在来到水晶城担任典狱长之前的事了，但有一些犯人却误以为他是最近受了重伤并准备越狱
这让狄曼列挺无语的，其余知情的犯人估计也是打算看这些小丑搞笑后被狄曼列收拾，所有没有人告诉她们实情
狄曼列没打算理会她们，只准备到时候把她们打个半死后挂在监狱门口
但和那些小丑犯人不一样，鸢尾花最深处关押的犯人，每一个都已经不能用危险来形容
这些甚至无法被称之为犯人的家伙，哪怕是狄曼列上次为了震慑犯人的那个夜晚，他也没有将这些家伙放出来
这些犯人，几乎都是狄曼列来到水晶城之前，也就是受伤之前就抓捕的，只是狄曼列不放心其中一部分，心里也有一些谋划，才将她们也一起带了过来
content_en:
All the prisoners in this area clearly remember that when the originally aloof vampire prince was tortured to the end, he no longer had any arrogance and resistance. He would only crawl like a dog at Dimanlie's feet and beg for mercy.
But Diamanlie still did not let her go. He did not intend to show any mercy to this kind of criminal who had touched the double bottom line of law and morality and had no regard for life. He just used holy water and curses over and over again to tear the body and soul of the blood prince. He even used soothing magic when her spirit was about to collapse, and then repeated the process.
Now the spirit and body of this vampire prince have actually been restored to their original state, but the memory and fear have been deeply ingrained into her instincts
Nowadays, she seems to be more thirsty for books and knowledge than for killing and blood. However, every time she sees Diamanlie during a walk, she will still pretend to be thinking about philosophy, and then run away quickly.
Almost every one of the felons imprisoned in this area has been repaired by Dimanlie, and there are many of them who have been repaired but have no long memory, but they basically only dare to curse a few ordinary swear words on their lips, and they must obey the orders and systems.
Putting aside his scrutiny of these serious criminals for the time being, Diamanlie did not immediately move to the front area, but lightly shook his cane.
As the sound of machine gunfire sounded, the main body of the cane instantly turned into a sharp chain saw, and a little weak but dangerous magic flowed through, exuding an aura that made the surrounding prisoners frightened.
Many prisoners have seen this cane. It is one of Demanlie's commonly used weapons. This weapon, which can be switched between a cane-shaped short blade and a chain saw, has left an indelible shadow in the hearts of all prisoners.
That was one night two years ago. As rumors spread that Dimanlie was seriously injured, many prisoners were ready to take action and even began to openly resist the prison guards and the order of the prison.
In this increasingly violent state of rioting by prisoners, the normal operation of the prison was greatly hindered, and many prison guards were injured. Even Helsa, who was Dimanlie's secretary at the time, almost lost her legs and became permanently disabled.
On a certain day, Diamanlie gave all the prison guards a holiday, then opened the doors of all the cells, and even removed the magical restraints on all the prisoners.
Just when the prisoners were not sure whether they were surprised or confused, Dimanlie's voice sounded from the radio.
"On this day only, I will release all restrictions. If you want to escape from prison, please come. I will wait for you at the front door. The forbidden spells have been activated in other places."
The prisoners are not fools, so they naturally suspect this is a conspiracy, but their desire for freedom has surpassed everything else. Except for some prisoners who only have a few months or even days left in their sentences, almost all other prisoners participated in this grand escape.
When this group of dangerous criminals who could easily destroy a large city came to the gate, they could only see the purple-haired young man sitting quietly under the moonlight, holding the cane quietly.
No one dared to go up immediately to test the truth of Dimanlie, and no one dared to step into the unknown conspiracy.
But as time passed, all the criminals still swarmed up and pounced on the not-strong purple-haired young man.
Facts have proved that they were wrong. It was not a conspiracy, but just a massacre.
That night, the square in front of the prison gate was dyed red
Heads, stumps, internal organs, and broken magic stones dyed the square into a scene of the kingdom of death.
With just a cane, all the magic, spells, powers, combat skills, scrolls, and magic tools were all torn apart easily like toys.
Until the moonlight alternated with the morning light, the only person standing in the square was the purple-haired young man who slowly turned the chain blade back into a cane.
His face and the black coat on his body were soaked with blood of various colors, but not a single drop of blood belonged to him. He was just silently counting the number of prisoners to kill and what to write.work report
Since then, no prisoner has dared to challenge the rules of Iris Prison. He can only silently put away his fangs like a wild dog encountering a ferocious beast.
At this moment, as Diamanlie flicked the chain saw, and then suddenly hit it on the ground, the cane appeared again.
He continued to walk towards the deepest area of the cell.
In fact, most people have assumed that the rumor that Diamanlie was once a heretic inquisitor is true.
It's just that both the prisoners and guards in Iris Prison, as well as the civilians and nobles of Crystal City, can't help but guess what level of heresy judge Diamanlie is.
If Diamanlie was really seriously injured, then with the strength he possesses now, he would definitely have been a high judge when he was not injured.
Such a being, even if seriously injured, should never be sent to a small city like Crystal City, let alone serve as the warden of a women's prison.
The reasons and Dimanlie's own attitude towards various things can, to a certain extent, indicate the direction of Crystal City in many fields.
It’s just that Diamanlie didn’t care about this for the time being. He ignored the eyes of the prisoners on both sides and slowly opened the door to the last area.
This is a door that only Dimanlie can open. All prison guards, including deputy warden Helsa, are only allowed to stay here. The magic circle and defense mechanism on it are enough to kill all the prisoners outside countless times, not to mention that the door itself is an alchemy product from a department of the Heretic Bureau.
As the verification steps were completed, the entire black alloy door suddenly lit up, followed by steam and magic lines all over the door, and then slowly opened
It is true that Dimanlie was seriously injured, but it was just before he came to Crystal City to serve as the warden. However, some prisoners mistakenly thought that he had been seriously injured recently and were preparing to escape.
This left Diamanlie quite speechless. The other prisoners who knew about it probably planned to watch these clowns make fun of themselves before being punished by Diamanlie, so no one told them the truth.
Diamanlie had no intention of paying attention to them, and was only planning to beat them half to death and hang them at the prison door.
But unlike those clown prisoners, every prisoner detained in the deepest part of Iris cannot be described as dangerous.
These guys who can't even be called prisoners, even on the night when Diamanlie wanted to scare the prisoners, he didn't release these guys.
Almost all of these prisoners were arrested before Diamanlie came to Crystal City, that is, before he was injured. However, Diamanlie was worried about some of them and had some plans in mind, so he brought them here too.
